title: Features
description: Switch off what you don't use. Nothing is deleted, and switching it back on brings it all back.

mainLanguage.title: Menu language
mainLanguage.description: The language your menu is written in.
mainLanguage.label: Your menu is written in
mainLanguage.hint: Every name needs it. While a second language is off, it is the only one guests see.
mainLanguage.missing: {{categories}} and {{dishes}} have no {{language}} name yet. Guests see their old name until you write one.
mainLanguage.confirmBody: What you wrote keeps its {{current}} text, which guests see until you write it in {{language}}. Nothing is deleted.

orders.label: Orders
orders.description: Guests add dishes to a cart and send you the order.
orders.offNote: Guests can't order from your menu while this is off. Orders you already have stay saved.
orders.whatsappHint: The order opens in WhatsApp for the guest to send you. It won't show on your Orders page, and we can't tell if it was sent or completed.
orders.menuHint: Guests order in the menu with their phone number and address. Orders arrive on your Orders page with a sound, so keep the dashboard open in a tab.

typeHints.delivery: Guests give their phone number and address.
typeHints.pickup: Guests give their phone number and collect it.

dine_in.label: Ordering at the table
dine_in.description: Each table gets its own QR code. Guests order straight to their table, no phone number needed, and orders arrive on the Table orders page. Works whatever you choose for orders above.
dine_in.offNote: Table QR codes still open your menu, but guests can't order to their table while this is off. Your tables are kept.

variants.label: Variants
variants.description: Choices on a dish, like size or spice level. Guests pick one, and each can add to the price.
variants.offNote: Your menu shows dishes without their variants while this is off. Your variants are kept.

addons.label: Add-ons
addons.description: Extras guests can add to a dish, like extra cheese, each with its own price.
addons.offNote: Your menu shows dishes without their add-ons while this is off. Your add-ons are kept.

qr.label: QR Studio
qr.description: Colours, shapes, your logo and a printable table card for your QR code.
qr.offNote: Your plain black QR code stays on the QR code page, ready to download. Your design is kept.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: How guests find your menu and what they do on it.

languages.label: Multiple languages
languages.description: Your menu in its main language and one more, with a switch for guests.
languages.offNote: Your menu shows its main language only. What you wrote in the other one is kept.
languages.secondHint: Changing it keeps what you wrote in the old language.
languages.saveFailed: Could not save your menu languages
